key_insight: Replace ad-hoc, real-time agent synthesis with a reusable, testable workflow-based architecture (the AI Workflow Store) so personal agents can be engineered, tested, and deployed with software-engineering rigor.
problem_solved: Current "on-the-fly" agent loops short-circuit standard software engineering practices, producing brittle, hard-to-test, and unsafe personal agents lacking reproducibility, adversarial evaluation, and staged rollout mechanisms.
method: Introduce an AI Workflow Store that captures, version-controls, and reuses agent workflows and subroutines instead of synthesizing everything at runtime.
Integrate engineering practices (automated testing, adversarial evaluation, CI/CD-style staging, policy checks, and monitoring) around stored workflows to validate behavior before deployment.
Provide runtime controls and observability (metrics, logging, rollback/guardrails) to enforce safety, enable audits, and iterate on workflows safely.
impact: Makes personal agents more reliable, auditable, and maintainable by bringing mature SE practices to agent design—reducing failures, improving safety, and enabling scalable team workflows for AI/ML practitioners.
